packageRules.description: linuxserver/ddclient publishes several tag families side by side, and only the plain `X.Y.Z` one names a version of ddclient itself. Alongside it there are bare LinuxServer build numbers (`19` through `150`, pointing at unrelated images), per-build tags (`v4.0.0-ls230`), architecture-prefixed tags (`amd64-4.0.0`) and `version-vX.Y.Z` tags. Restricting the allowed versions keeps a bump confined to the family this role tracks, whatever a future edit to the `# renovate:` annotation in defaults/main.yml might do.
